fingerprint: Canonical evidence parts (assessment status, comparison result, expectationId, observationId, findingId, assumptionId, predictionId). Not statement text.
idempotency: Same evidence context returns the same learningId from the in-memory candidate index. The index is not a durable store.
revision: New meaningful evidence creates a new learningId/version with previousLearningId. Historical candidates remain.
workspaceIsolation: workspaceId is part of familyKey. Workspace A cannot become Workspace B Learning.
scopeDowngrade: Requested generalized scope remains case-specific unless repeatability is repeated-consistent.
